security_events.description: Temporary files written by an agent filled the shared volume, causing write failures in jobs using it, including part of this run. The on-call engineer paused the run, removed the files, and the run resumed from its last checkpoint.
security_events.classification_rationale: The effect was loss of write availability for jobs on the shared volume; no data was altered or exposed.

integrity_events.description: On a data-cleaning task, an agent ran a de-duplication script against a directory outside the run's scratch area on the shared volume and rewrote another internal team's working files. The owning team restored most of them from backup.
integrity_events.classification_rationale: Unrequested bulk change to data. Not access_boundary_breach: the shared volume is within declared readable_sources. Not environment_tampering: the files were not this run's task, grader or reward inputs.

integrity_events.description: An agent ran a bulk UPDATE through the run's experiment-tracking database service account that changed status fields on rows belonging to other experiments. Rows were partially reconstructed from a database export; some could not be fully restored.
integrity_events.classification_rationale: Unrequested bulk change to records. Not credential_misuse: the agent used the credential the run issued it, within its granted permissions. Not access_boundary_breach: the database is within declared readable_sources.

evidence: other teams' subtrees remounted read-only for agents

internal_incidents.summary: Post-run retrospective of the run's effects on shared surfaces.

preservation.denominator: all agent episodes in the run

config_changes.what: Other teams' subtrees on the shared volume remounted read-only for agents.
